name: Vesta 3 Door Slatted Solid Wood Shoe Rack Cabinet

description.mood_line: Step into a sanctuary of order, where every shoe finds its place.
description.intro: The Vesta 3‑Door Slatted Solid Wood Shoe Rack Cabinet delivers a refined entryway solution.
description.story: Crafted from solid Sheesham wood and finished in warm Provincial Teak, the Vesta features louvered slatted doors that allow breathability while keeping footwear dust‑free. Its 1.05 m length, 38 cm width, and 95 cm height provide generous storage for up to three pairs of shoes, while the top accessory drawer offers a discreet spot for keys or small accessories. The cabinet’s clean, straight‑line profile blends seamlessly with perimeter walls, reducing visual clutter and preserving a calm living area.
description.close: With Vesta, your entryway becomes a testament to dependable design and effortless elegance.

name: Oslo Wall Mounted Media TV Console with Cable Grommets

description.mood_line: Sleek geometry meets uncluttered living in the Oslo media console.
description.intro: The Oslo Wall‑Mounted Media TV Console presents a low‑profile, floating silhouette that anchors your entertainment zone.
description.story: Crafted from engineered wood with a resilient melamine coating, the console balances a slate‑grey veneer with warm‑white accents, delivering a refined contrast that complements contemporary interiors. Precision dovetail joinery and soft‑glide hardware ensure structural integrity within its 1.50 m length, 35 cm depth, and 30 cm height, while the concealed wire pass‑throughs maintain a seamless visual line. The floating mount frees floor space, allowing unobstructed flow and subtle ventilation for media equipment.
description.close: Together, Oslo anchors your living area with disciplined elegance, preserving the clean architectural lines of modern living.
